constellations.name: SME digital-transformation implementation -> assessment/audit -> acceptance -> subsidy settlement
constellations.world_change_or_friction: Xuzhou is in an active 2026-2027 national SME digital-transformation trial. The public process now forces hundreds of firms and service providers through diagnosis, contract filing, implementation, digital-level assessment, audit, acceptance and subsidy disbursement. The existence of a repeated acceptance interface is proven; whether it creates outsourceable remediation tasks is not yet proven.

observed: Pilot enterprises contract digital-transformation service providers under market principles.
Xuzhou Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology is the program authority and organizes filing, assessment/acceptance and subsidy processes.
Third-party assessment and acceptance organizations have already been procured by government.
unknown: Who would pay an independent orchestrator for a remediation or specialist-routing task: the enterprise, its primary service provider, or nobody.
Whether an approved service provider may subcontract or referral-route a bounded specialist task and share economics.

constellations.valued_outcome: A filed digital-transformation project reaches the required digital level, passes assessment/audit/acceptance, has complete and consistent evidence, produces measurable operating effects and becomes eligible for subsidy settlement.

node_constellation.node: Xuzhou Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology and district/county industry authorities
node_constellation.control: program rules, filing review, coordination, subsidy process

node_constellation.node: pilot manufacturing SMEs in engineering-machinery/parts and safety-emergency-equipment/parts
node_constellation.control: project contract, internal systems/data, acceptance materials, operating adoption

node_constellation.node: approved or otherwise qualified digital-transformation service providers
node_constellation.control: implementation, integration, training, operations support, evidence support

node_constellation.node: third-party digital-level assessment, audit and acceptance organizations
node_constellation.control: assessment reports, audit results, acceptance judgement

node_constellation.node: bounded external specialists or products that may solve a specific integration, data-collection, evidence, AI or operational gap
node_constellation.control: UNKNOWN until a primary contractor or enterprise options the node

observed_facts: The 2026-2027 Xuzhou plan targets 650 SME digital transformations in two manufacturing sectors, all reaching digital level 2 or above, at least 20 service providers and at least 120 small/fast/light/precise solutions, with 2026 H2 explicitly used for diagnosis, implementation, assessment, audit, acceptance and first subsidy disbursement.

The filing rules allow a pilot enterprise to use a provider outside the official pool only if additional provider qualification material is filed; the enterprise bears the resulting service/acceptance risk.

The filing review checks diagnosis-report truth/targeting, service-contract completeness/compliance/price reasonableness and consistency between diagnosis and contract; a failed review gets a five-working-day correction window before re-review.
Eligible completed projects that pass acceptance can receive a subsidy up to 70% of actual eligible investment, capped by post-transformation digital level at RMB 200k/250k/300k per enterprise.

A government procurement contract covers digital-level assessment for 650 firms across 245, 216 and 189-firm packages; the first two packages were awarded in August 2026 and the third package was retendered with a 2026-09-16 bid deadline.

A separate RMB 2.2m third-party acceptance procurement was awarded for RMB 2.197m to China CEPREI East China Laboratory plus Xuzhou Huashe Information Technology; acceptance uses document review, on-site verification, personnel interviews and effectiveness determination and runs through the trial completion window.
Public September 2026 notices state that service providers must help enterprises prepare acceptance/subsidy materials and necessary technical support.
inferences_not_yet_facts: Repeated assessment and acceptance will probably surface bounded remediation tasks, but public evidence does not yet prove any specific service provider has a current uncovered task.

An orchestrator could create value if it can translate an acceptance blocker into a rights-safe task packet, option a specialist node, define acceptance evidence and route settlement without becoming the implementer.
The strongest possible wedge is not generic digital consulting; it is a specific blocker that the primary service provider cannot or will not solve efficiently before an acceptance milestone.
constellations.access_basis: The program, rules, service-provider pool, assessment/acceptance contracts and public contacts are observable. Commercial access to an enterprise task remains unproven.
constellations.permission_boundary: Do not contact or access enterprise systems/data without explicit authorization. Any specialist task must sit inside the enterprise/provider contractual, cybersecurity, confidentiality and acceptance boundaries.
constellations.optioning_mechanism_hypothesis: Obtain one redacted field packet from a primary service provider or pilot enterprise that names a current blocker, deadline, acceptance evidence, decision authority, allowed external role and fee/budget boundary; only then option the specialist node.
constellations.controller_incentive_or_surplus: A primary service provider or enterprise has an incentive only if routing the bounded blocker reduces time/risk/cost of reaching acceptance more than coordinating it internally. This surplus is UNKNOWN until one live packet exists.

interface_hypothesis.input: redacted current-state evidence + target acceptance criterion + system/process boundary + deadline + permissions
interface_hypothesis.acceptance: primary provider/enterprise accepts the deliverable and it survives the relevant assessment/acceptance check
interface_hypothesis.settlement: UNKNOWN; must be explicit before work starts

constellations.replaceability: Potentially high if task packets and acceptance evidence are standardized after observing repeated blocker classes; currently UNKNOWN because zero live routed tasks have been observed.
constellations.founder_role: Define the truth contract, acquire one legitimate field packet, separate controller/payer/worker roles, source and option the specialist, define acceptance/settlement and observe outcome. Founder must not become the default ERP/MES implementer or acceptance-document clerk.
constellations.founder_replacement_path: After repeated tasks exist, field-packet acquisition and specialist execution become external roles; founder retains route design, evidence contract, node composition, trust/risk governance and learning.

cheapest_decisive_validation.test: Ask 3-5 publicly confirmed first-batch service providers for exactly one redacted, currently active pilot-enterprise blocker that is (a) already inside a filed/contracted project, (b) material to a near-term assessment/acceptance outcome, (c) not efficiently solvable by the provider's current team, and (d) legally shareable with an external specialist. Require the packet to identify decision authority, deadline, acceptance evidence and whether a bounded external fee/subcontract/referral is permitted.
cheapest_decisive_validation.pass: At least one provider returns a real bounded packet and confirms a legitimate external execution/fee path; then option one non-founder specialist and seek explicit task authorization before execution.
cheapest_decisive_validation.fail: Providers report no uncovered tasks, refuse any external node, cannot share even redacted task evidence, or all economics vanish unless founder personally performs implementation/admin labor.

counterevidence: The city has already selected full-chain service providers and specialist third-party assessment/acceptance organizations, so many coordination functions may already be contractually internalized.
Approved providers are required to perform implementation, integration, training, operations support, data reporting and knowledge output, making a generic middleman redundant.
The program explicitly emphasizes traceability, price reasonableness and anti-fraud controls; an unnecessary intermediary would add compliance risk rather than value.
kill_conditions: No primary service provider or enterprise can expose a current bounded blocker under lawful confidentiality boundaries.
Existing contracts already require and efficiently provide the missing specialist capability at lower coordination cost.
No payer/controller permits external task routing or fee attribution.
Founder must personally deliver recurring implementation work for economics to exist.
The deliverable cannot be tied to an observable acceptance criterion.

constellations.name: Four-chain public enterprise technology-demand stream -> external capability -> institutional introduction/submission
constellations.world_change_or_friction: A city industry-research institution operates a public platform that co-locates enterprise technology demands, technical results, universities/research organizations, scientific-instrument sharing and a visible 'submit solution' path. The main blocker is no longer discovery of demand records; it is whether displayed statuses are operationally current and whether an independent orchestrator can lawfully participate with attributable economics.

observed: Named enterprises are attached to public technology-demand records and some records disclose intended R&D investment.
Xuzhou Industrial Technology Research Institute operates the platform and is the institutional routing/trust node.
unknown: Whether any selected demand remains live with an approved 2026 budget and decision owner.
Whether the platform attributes source/origination and permits an independent individual/organization to bring a solution team for a fee or service economics.

constellations.valued_outcome: A live enterprise technology problem is matched to a qualified non-founder capability node through a legitimate introduction or solution-submission path, with enterprise acceptance and attribution/economic terms known before delivery.

node_constellation.node: named Xuzhou enterprises publishing technical or procurement demands
Xuzhou Industrial Technology Research Institute / Four-Chain Integration Public Service Platform
universities, research institutes, labs, specialist firms and authorized experts
public problem statement, technical indicators, intended investment, cooperation mode and solution-submission interface

observed_facts: The platform explicitly states that it aggregates technology, capital, talent and policy resources and provides industry-university-research matching, technology-transfer and capital/talent services.
The enterprise-demand list contains named demand owners, problem descriptions and a visible solution-submission action.

Examples include engineering-machinery R&D demands with disclosed intended investment such as digital high-pressure multiway valve technology (RMB 6m), high-compute/domain-control and automation problems, and older records such as the intelligent tower-crane control system (RMB 6m) that explicitly requires reliability testing.
Some demand-list pages are still rendered as 'in progress' even though their publication dates are in 2023-2024. Therefore public status is not sufficient evidence of live 2026 authority or budget.
A prior institutional inquiry has already been sent before this run; Issue #143 correctly remains fail-closed at INSTITUTIONAL_TRUTH_PENDING. No additional external message was sent in this run.
inferences_not_yet_facts: If the institution accepts externally sourced solution teams and preserves origination/service economics, an orchestrator can build repeatable routing without becoming the technical worker.

If the platform's 'submit solution' path is only a direct bilateral introduction with no room for an independent routing principal, the commercial role may disappear even though matching socially occurs.
constellations.access_basis: Public demand records and institutional contact path are observable; operational permission and economics are pending institutional confirmation.
constellations.permission_boundary: Do not treat masked/public enterprise data as authority to contact technical personnel or disclose demand details beyond published material. No enterprise/professor outreach until institutional participation boundary is clarified.
constellations.optioning_mechanism_hypothesis: After one demand is confirmed live, option one non-founder domain analyst/capability team against the published acceptance indicators, then use the institution's legitimate solution-submission/introduction path.
constellations.controller_incentive_or_surplus: The institution/enterprise benefits only if the route brings a credible capability faster or with lower search/coordination risk than the existing platform process. Attribution economics remain UNKNOWN.

interface_hypothesis.input: one institution-confirmed live demand + acceptance indicators + cooperation boundary
interface_hypothesis.output: one qualified solution team and bounded solution/evidence packet
interface_hypothesis.acceptance: enterprise/institution agrees the team satisfies submission/introduction threshold

constellations.replaceability: Potentially high because demand analysis and technical delivery can be external nodes; unproven until one legitimate routed introduction occurs.
constellations.founder_role: Select the live demand, define evidence and role interfaces, option the non-founder analyst/capability node, govern attribution/risk and observe outcome. Founder is not the engineer solving the technical problem.
constellations.founder_replacement_path: Domain analysis and technical proposal become replaceable specialist roles; founder retains routing control and institutional relationships.

cheapest_decisive_validation.window: Already running; next information arrives on institutional reply or an explicitly authorized follow-up
cheapest_decisive_validation.test: Require the institution to establish demand freshness, independent-participant eligibility, legitimate submission/introduction path, enterprise-contact ownership, minimum evidence, IP/confidentiality rules, repeatability and any attribution/service-fee economics. If confirmed, select exactly one live demand and option exactly one non-founder solution node before any delivery work.
cheapest_decisive_validation.pass: One live demand + one allowed external routing path + one optionable non-founder capability + explicit attribution/economic boundary.
cheapest_decisive_validation.fail: Statuses are stale, no independent routing role is allowed, enterprise access cannot be authorized, or no economic/attribution path exists beyond founder doing uncompensated brokering.

counterevidence: Many visible demand records are old, so the apparent pipeline may contain stale records.
The platform itself already performs matching and technology-transfer functions; an external orchestrator must add more than introducing two parties who could already meet through the platform.
Published intended investment is not proof of a current approved budget or willingness to pay an external route owner.
kill_conditions: No selected record can be confirmed as live.
The institution does not permit independent solution routing or source attribution.
No legitimate economic role exists for the orchestrator.
The only workable path requires the founder to become the technical delivery worker.

public enterprise-demand stream and solution-submission action
named engineering-machinery demands and disclosed intended R&D investment
tower-crane control demand with explicit reliability-test requirement and RMB 6m intended investment
platform partner and innovation-resource topology

constellations.name: Enterprise validation/test need -> fragmented university/research instrument platforms -> paid external test result
constellations.world_change_or_friction: Xuzhou publicly exposes multiple university/research scientific-instrument platforms and enterprise technology demands that require testing or reliability validation. External paid use is demonstrably possible at China University of Mining and Technology. What is not proven is a current enterprise failure caused by instrument/method/provider search or coordination.

observed: External users can pay for CUMT scientific-instrument use under a service agreement and receive test results.
Instrument-owning university/research units control scheduling, methods, service agreements, fees and results.
unknown: A current enterprise payer with a test/validation task that is blocked by provider/method fragmentation.
Whether labs allow or reward an external referral/orchestration role rather than direct customer booking.

constellations.valued_outcome: An enterprise gets the correct method/instrument/provider, sample/preparation requirements, lead time, price and accepted result/report without repeated search and failed handoffs.

node_constellation.node: enterprise with material, component, reliability or R&D validation task
CUMT instrument-sharing platform and other Xuzhou university/research testing centers
instrument-owning platform/college administrators who approve external service and fees
method selection, sample specification, booking, service agreement, payment/invoice, result/report

observed_facts: The Xuzhou Four-Chain platform's scientific-instrument section links Shanghai Jiao Tong University Xuzhou New Materials Research Institute, Jiangsu Normal University Analysis and Testing Center and CUMT instrument-sharing platform as distinct access points.

CUMT's current Materials and Physics experimental/testing center states that it has 118 shared instruments with total value about RMB 48m, including 21 instruments above RMB 400k, and describes the center as combining teaching, research and public service.

CUMT's published sharing rules state that instrument sharing is paid, permit separate external-user fee schedules, and define an external-user flow of platform query/booking -> service agreement -> payment/invoice -> test -> result.

The Four-Chain technology-demand corpus includes enterprise tasks that explicitly require reliability or performance testing, proving that test/validation is part of some valued outcomes, but those records are not yet confirmed live for 2026.
inferences_not_yet_facts: Because access points and methods are fragmented, some SMEs may value a test-routing layer that turns an engineering question into the right method/provider/evidence package.
This becomes commercially distinct only if a live payer experiences coordination/search friction that direct lab booking does not solve.
constellations.access_basis: External paid access exists at least at CUMT; multiple local testing resources are publicly discoverable.
constellations.permission_boundary: Labs retain method/scheduling/safety/data/report authority. Never resell lab access or claim certification authority without an explicit agreement.
constellations.optioning_mechanism_hypothesis: Obtain a live, non-confidential enterprise test objective; request capability/lead-time/quote boundaries from two or more legitimate centers; route only after the enterprise chooses and the lab accepts the sample/method.
constellations.controller_incentive_or_surplus: Enterprise surplus would be fewer failed tests, shorter search/lead time or a more acceptance-ready evidence package; lab surplus would be qualified external demand. Neither is yet measured.

interface_hypothesis.input: engineering question + sample/material + required decision/report + deadline/confidentiality
interface_hypothesis.output: method/provider routing packet and lab-produced result/report
interface_hypothesis.acceptance: enterprise confirms the result answers the pre-defined decision criterion
interface_hypothesis.settlement: direct lab fee is proven possible; orchestrator economics are UNKNOWN

constellations.replaceability: Testing execution is inherently non-founder and replaceable across capable labs; routing itself is only valuable if repeated search/method friction is observed.
constellations.founder_role: Define the enterprise question and evidence contract, compare legitimate providers, manage permissions and handoffs; do not perform laboratory testing.
constellations.founder_replacement_path: A field scout can collect test packets and lab coordinators execute tests; founder retains route and quality governance if a repeated pattern emerges.

cheapest_decisive_validation.test: Find one current enterprise task requiring a specific test/reliability decision. Before touching a sample, ask two local shared/testing platforms for method fit, sample requirements, lead time, deliverable/report type and price. Separately ask the enterprise whether direct lab discovery/coordination is currently a material blocker and whether it would pay for a bounded routing/evidence service in addition to lab fees.
cheapest_decisive_validation.pass: A live enterprise confirms material coordination friction and a paid/authorized routing role, with at least one lab accepting the test under explicit terms.
cheapest_decisive_validation.fail: The enterprise can directly book the correct lab with negligible friction, no additional routing fee is acceptable, or required testing/report authority is unavailable.

counterevidence: CUMT already has a direct external-user booking/agreement/payment process, so a generic test broker is unnecessary.
The Four-Chain platform already exposes local instrument-sharing links, reducing pure discovery friction.
No current enterprise test packet or willingness-to-pay evidence has been observed.
kill_conditions: No live enterprise test/validation task is obtained.
Direct lab access is already easy enough that routing adds no measurable value.
No lab accepts the required method/sample/report under lawful external-use rules.
Orchestrator economics require falsely representing certification, lab authority or proprietary methods.

evidence.claim: Xuzhou scientific-instrument sharing directory exposes multiple separate platforms
current CUMT materials/testing center instrument scale and public-service function
CUMT paid sharing, external fee rules and external-user service flow
enterprise technology demand includes explicit reliability testing as a valued technical outcome
Shanghai Jiao Tong University Xuzhou New Materials Research Institute has built integrated R&D/testing capability and reported external enterprise testing cooperation

constellations.name: Residual tacit knowledge after existing SOP/training -> bounded cue extraction -> non-expert performance transfer
constellations.world_change_or_friction: Existing master-technician studios and mature OEM service/training systems already codify substantial engineering knowledge. The candidate survives only as a narrow residual-performance question: is there a measurable, rights-clearable expert advantage that remains after the existing SOP/training baseline and can transfer to a non-expert?

observed: Employers/training organizations control access to tasks, experts, SOPs and proprietary knowledge.
unknown: A complementary actor willing to make an economic commitment for that residual layer.

constellations.valued_outcome: Measurable improvement in diagnosis, inspection, machining or training performance over the existing SOP/training baseline without requiring the expert in every case.

node_constellation.node: authorized master technicians or service experts
residual decision cues not already represented in SOP/training
employer or training institution controlling rights and task access
non-expert users, training programs, service teams or industrial-AI/evaluation teams

observed_facts: The existing repository candidate already records public evidence of master studios, formal mentoring and conversion of frontline experience into standards/processes, which is direct counterevidence to a broad 'stranded veteran knowledge' story.

XCMG currently advertises a dense integrated lifecycle service system: 280 China product offices, 353 dealers, 294 parts centers, 3,671 outlets and more than 17,000 sales/service personnel, plus preventive maintenance, fault diagnosis, emergency support, rental, used-equipment, overhaul and remanufacturing services.

XCMG also markets digital equipment management/service flows and continued expansion of aftermarket services, strengthening the counterevidence that generic maintenance knowledge or service access is stranded.
inferences_not_yet_facts: A residual tacit layer may still exist in unusual diagnostics or exception handling, but no public evidence proves it survives current codification at economically meaningful magnitude.
If an authorized transfer experiment works, the orchestrator could package verification, rights and routing rather than sell expert hours.
constellations.access_basis: UNKNOWN; requires employer-authorized task and expert participation.
constellations.permission_boundary: No extraction of trade secrets, confidential repair data, proprietary process parameters or employee know-how outside employer authorization.
constellations.optioning_mechanism_hypothesis: Employer authorizes one non-confidential task, expert, baseline users and rights boundary for a controlled transfer experiment.
constellations.controller_incentive_or_surplus: Only exists if the extracted residual cue improves performance beyond current SOP/training and lowers repeated expert dependency enough to justify the experiment.

interface_hypothesis.input: authorized task + existing SOP/training baseline + matched cases
interface_hypothesis.acceptance: a non-expert reproduces part of the expert's measured advantage on held-out cases
interface_hypothesis.settlement: UNKNOWN; no commercial claim before performance and rights proof

constellations.replaceability: The whole purpose is to make scarce judgement less person-dependent; currently unproven.
constellations.founder_role: Design the evidence/rights experiment and route authorized expert, evaluator and user roles; do not become the technician or trainer.
constellations.founder_replacement_path: Experiment facilitation and measurement can become external roles if a repeatable residual-knowledge class is observed.

cheapest_decisive_validation.window: 1-2 weeks after employer access is obtained
cheapest_decisive_validation.test: Use the repository's existing experiment: one authorized non-confidential maintenance/inspection/machining task with an existing SOP; compare baseline users versus an authorized expert, capture only permitted incremental cues, then give those cues to another non-expert and measure held-out performance while obtaining explicit rights boundaries.
cheapest_decisive_validation.pass: Stable expert advantage remains after baseline control, the responsible cues can be captured lawfully, and a non-expert reproduces a meaningful part of the improvement.
cheapest_decisive_validation.fail: Current SOP/training already captures the performance, expert advantage is non-transferable, rights cannot be cleared, or no complementary actor makes a costly commitment.

counterevidence: Mature master-studio and training systems already transfer knowledge.
OEM service/parts/aftermarket networks are already heavily coordinated and digitized.
Generic repair-routing or 'old engineer knowledge' is therefore not a valid opportunity premise.
kill_conditions: No measurable residual advantage over current SOP/training.
Useful cues are confidential or rights cannot be cleared.
Cue transfer does not improve non-expert held-out performance.
Existing internal training transfers the same value at lower cost.

evidence.claim: existing candidate and residual-only doctrine
current dense XCMG lifecycle service and aftermarket network
2026 digital service/app and lifecycle-service expansion counterevidence

why_selected: The external change is current in August-September 2026 rather than inferred from an old status label.
Payer/controller roles, formal project contracts, assessment/acceptance interfaces and subsidy deadlines are concrete.
A decisive failure signal is cheap: if primary providers cannot produce even one lawful bounded uncovered blocker with an external fee path, the orchestrator wedge is killed quickly.
No irreversible capital or founder technical delivery is needed for the validation.

why_kept_alive: A heterogeneous demand/institution/capability structure is publicly visible.
The founder can remain the routing control plane if institutional participation and economics are confirmed.
An institutional inquiry is already pending, so the incremental cost of waiting for truth is near zero.

hold_not_killed.reason: Access and paid external service are stronger than demand/friction evidence; first obtain one live enterprise test packet before treating fragmentation as value.
Residual knowledge remains scientifically testable but access/rights and stranding are harder than the active digital-acceptance route, while OEM service maturity supplies strong counterevidence.

explicitly_deprioritized_structure.name: generic Xuzhou engineering-machinery repair/aftermarket routing
explicitly_deprioritized_structure.reason: Current XCMG evidence shows an already-integrated nationwide/global service, dealer, parts, rental, used-equipment, overhaul and remanufacturing network. Without evidence of a specific uncovered multi-brand/out-of-warranty edge case, a generic repair-routing thesis fails the stranding/coordination test.

only_required_roles: define the minimum field packet and evidence contract
option one non-founder capability only after a live task exists
govern confidentiality, attribution and failure conditions
observe outcome and update route truth
roles_to_avoid: unpaid introduction broker without attribution economics

next_blocker: Obtain one lawful, redacted, currently active digital-transformation acceptance/remediation blocker from a controller that also states whether an external specialist and fee/subcontract/referral path are permitted. Until that packet exists, XZ-DIGITAL-ACCEPTANCE-001 remains VALIDATION_READY_HYPOTHESIS, not a commercial opportunity.
external_contact_policy: Research, target-list construction and draft preparation are allowed. No email, direct message, phone call or other real outreach is authorized by this artifact. No external outreach was sent during this run.
